name: SF Fin
description: Connect SF Pi to a Fin (formerly Intercom) workspace with a Pi-owned, masked personal API token and a read-only doctor check through the installed Fin CLI.

docs.summary: Provides Pi-native `/login sf-fin`, which asks for the workspace hosting region and collects a Fin personal API token through SF Pi's shared fixed-mask input. Pi alone persists the credential. The `sf_fin` family tool and `/sf-fin` command expose cached status and a read-only doctor that runs the user's installed Fin CLI (`intercom --version`, `intercom me`) with the token in the child-process environment only and an SF Pi-private CLI config directory.
stateFiles: ~/.pi/agent/auth.json entry: sf-fin (Pi-owned API key plus credential.env.INTERCOM_REGION)
safety: Interactive `/login sf-fin` masks the personal API token through SF Pi's shared credential input and returns it to Pi under provider id `sf-fin`; SF Fin writes no second secret store.

The token reaches the Fin CLI only through an allowlisted child-process environment, never argv, and the child uses an SF Pi-private `INTERCOM_CONFIG_DIR`, so the user's own CLI keychain entry and `~/.intercom` files are never read or written.
CLI output is scrubbed of the token before it reaches status, tool results, or logs; status files store only non-secret workspace identity.
v1 runs only `intercom --version` and `intercom me`, which are read-only and do not trigger the CLI's automatic Fin SDK enablement.
